Quantum 1.7.2 was certified on 2026-07-19. It pins **nucleus v1.3.3**, **quark v1.3.2** and **orbit v1.4.3**.

A patch release of the suite after Quantum 1.7.1: nucleus goes from v1.3.2 to v1.3.3 (patch), quark goes from v1.3.1 to v1.3.2 (patch) and orbit goes from v1.4.2 to v1.4.3 (patch).
